messages:
sneh: FYI noticed an account showing a provisional credit flip to negative after a retry+toolcall during a canary. not a huge customer but visible in console. :frowning:
liam: which canary / region? any trace ids?
sneh: canary id=canary-2025-09 region failover us-west->ap-south session ses_0BqKdZ msg attached. looked like a streaming response spawned a toolcall, client reconnected, router retried to a different region, and provisional dropped below 0.
chao: can you paste the router+ledger excerpt?
sneh: logs (sanitized):
```
router.INFO: session=ses_0BqKdZ route=us-west -> fallback=ap-south reconnect=true prefetch=true
sidecar.DEBUG: prefetch_toolcall_id=ptc_9001 attached
router.DEBUG: outbound_headers: X-Toolcall-Idempotency: (missing)
ledger.INFO: session=ses_0BqKdZ provisional_charge=+30 note=toolcall-start
ledger.INFO: session=ses_0BqKdZ reconcile_adjust=-45 reason=dedupe-finalize
ui.DEBUG: provisional_balance_before=+30 provisional_balance_after=-15
```
chao: aha outbound header missing on fallback path. sidecar had ptc_9001 but router failed to propagate X-Toolcall-Idempotency, so target region created a new toolcall and later ledger reconciled by subtracting what it thought was duplicate.
liam: negative showing in UI is bad. our accounting can go negative internally for reconciliation but UI/CS should never see negative provisional. we should clamp server-side in the usage API and mark as reconciled/correction so CS knows.
avery: avery? (cc UI) can we show a clear strand in console: "provisional corrections applied" with hover text? and avoid showing negative numbers.
avery: yep. will draft a small UI patch: display 0 and show a yellow banner: "Provisional corrections reduced available credits; details in billing history."
chao: root cause fix: router needs to preserve idempotency header and sidecar prefetch id on fallback. i'll add code to copy prefetch_toolcall_id -> X-Toolcall-Idempotency and to include it in the reconnect routing metadata. also add unit test for header roundtrip.
liam: ledger side: add guard that when applying reconcile_adjust we do not expose provisional < 0 in API responses, and add an auditing event so we can trace negative corrections back to router fallbacks. i'll open a PR.
sneh: can we also emit a telemetry tag when reconcile_adjust happens due to dedupe-finalize so we can alert on frequency? saw 3 in last 24h.
liam: good call. add metric: billing.reconcile.dedupe_finalized with tags {region, canary}. ops-bot can pick that up and create alerts if rate > 1/min for canary.
infra-bot: Canary pause: canary-2025-09 paused at 2025-09-04T14:12Z due to provisional anomalies.
sneh: SRE: can you run staged replay? steps in bug PLAT-3579, but quick repro: 1) enable prefetch, 2) start stream with header X-Toolcall-Idempotency: ptc_9001, 3) kill connection mid-stream, 4) let router fallback to another region, 5) inspect billing provisional.
chao: router patch ETA: 8h for unit tests + canary tomorrow. will also add integration test that simulates lost header scenario to catch regressions.
liam: ledger hotfix: server-side clamp and telemetry emit. ETA 1.5h, will push to canary immediately after.
avery: UI hotfix: clamp display + banner copy. ETA 3h. will coordinate with liam to ensure API provides a flag showing correction reason.
sneh: adding owners to PLAT-3579: liam (ledger), chao (router), avery (console), sneh (reporter/SRE).
ops-bot: Alert created: PLAT-3579 provisional-negative-detected count=3 window=24h severity=medium tags=[canary-2025-09 prefetch sidecar].
liam: I'll include log annotations in PR so CS can correlate user-facing timelines with ledger corrections.
avery: UI copy suggestion: "A provisional billing correction was applied after a routed retry; final charges will appear in billing history."
sneh: thanks. one more ask: add a reconciliation run that checks for accounts with provisional < 0 and auto-creates a follow-up audit. don't want manual CS tickets.
liam: agree. will gate the reconcile audit to only run when provisional < 0 to prevent noise.
chao: will make router change conservative: forward header only when prefetch=true and session has prefetch_toolcall_id set. avoid leaking random headers.
infra-bot: deployment note: ledger hotfix canary pushed at 2025-09-04T15:40Z; monitoring enabled.
sneh: closing loop for now. followups in PLAT-3579. thanks all. :pray:
